questions.prompt: Which of the following liver enzymes is NOT GPI-anchored?
questions.note: Both A (GGT) and C (ALT) are accepted for the exact printed wording. ALT is soluble; GGT is membrane anchored by a transmembrane segment, not a GPI anchor.
